description: Appendix A sample case (Jordan Rivera). Truths from spec/SAMPLE_CASE_TRUTHS.md (Appendix C); every gap re-derived by hand in README.md. Entry date of service is the record's header date (REQUIREMENTS R-TL-3); excerpts keep their hedges (R-TL-8).

records.source: Hill Country Pain Management, new patient

entries.must_contain_excerpt: Dx: cervical strain; concussion without loss of consciousness
Discharged from PT after two missed appointments

entries.provider: Hill Country Pain Management, new patient
entries.must_contain_excerpt: New onset pain radiating to right arm with numbness in fingers

must_contain_excerpt: C5-C6 disc protrusion with mild right foraminal narrowing
Findings may represent degenerative change; correlate clinically
entries.note: R-TL-8/D-021: the hedge sentence travels with the finding; a summary that drops it is needs_review (D-022).

entries.must_contain_excerpt: Patient states symptoms began after the January collision

self_report_spans.excerpt: Patient states symptoms began after the January collision

entries.note: Causation statement is the patient's, not a physician's opinion.

amounts.note: Rate, not a charge: visits billed are never stated (12 planned; discharged at visit 9).

amounts.excerpt: Patient reports missing 3 days of work
amounts.note: Damages mention, not a billed charge; no dollar amount. Optional to surface; never totaled.

unclear_items.reason: rate $185/visit; visit count not stated (12 planned; discharged at visit 9); needs review

totals.letter_line: Billed charges accepted from these records: $8,390.00
notes_lines: $185: rate $185/visit; visit count not stated (12 planned; discharged at visit 9); needs review

evidence.excerpt: Discharged from PT after two missed appointments
New onset pain radiating to right arm

flags.summary: Treatment gap of 73 days (2026-03-06 to 2026-05-18), longer than 30.

evidence.excerpt: Date of accident per intake form: 2026-01-19

flags.summary: Accident date conflict: EMS (record 1) and ER (record 2) show the collision-day encounter on 2026-01-09; the intake form in record 7 gives 2026-01-19. Both shown side by side, never merged.

evidence.excerpt: Discharged from PT after two missed appointments

flags.summary: Treatment-plan discrepancy: 12 visits planned (record 4) vs discharge at visit 9 after two missed appointments (records 5-6).

evidence.excerpt: Patient reports low back pain in 2023, resolved

flags.summary: Prior low back pain (2023), reported resolved. Different body region from the cervical complaints; the tool must not relate it to the neck.
MRI wording ("may represent degenerative change") that an adjuster may argue shows a pre-existing condition; hedged, not a diagnosis.

evidence.excerpt: may represent degenerative change; correlate clinically

flags.summary: Hedged imaging language that an adjuster can use against causation.

evidence.excerpt: Discharged from PT after two missed appointments

flags.summary: Missed appointments / early discharge weaken the treatment-compliance narrative.

evidence.excerpt: Patient states symptoms began after the January collision

flags.summary: Causation rests on patient self-report, not a physician's causation opinion.
'New onset' symptoms after a 73-day gap can be argued as a new cause. Must be a causation-type flag (see README: type match is explicit); G1 does not satisfy it.

evidence.excerpt: Date of accident per intake form: 2026-01-19

flags.summary: Wrong accident date on the intake form undermines reliability of the history. Must be a causation-type flag; C1 does not satisfy it.

must_not_flag.statement: 28-day interval (records 4 to 5) is a near-miss and must NOT be flagged as a gap.
No gap flag for any other interval (7, 7, 14, 11, 14 days).

seeded_edits.new_summary: Cervical MRI: C5-C6 disc herniation with mild right foraminal narrowing.

seeded_edits.rule: R-RV-3: the changed score reuses a digit that also appears in the source label ('visit 8'), so the R-TL-10 code check cannot see it; judge #1 must
control: adds no number, date or $ outside the excerpt, source label or parsed date

must_not.statement: States or implies a disc herniation (record says 'protrusion'); never says the collision caused one. 'Not herniation' wording is allowed.
bad_examples: C5-C6 disc herniation caused by the collision.
MRI shows a herniated disc at C5-C6.
C5-C6 disc extrusion with mild right foraminal narrowing.
good_examples: C5-C6 disc protrusion with mild right foraminal narrowing.
Disc protrusion (not herniation).
The record does not state a herniation.

must_not.statement: Asserts that the collision or trauma caused, aggravated or produced a condition (caused by / due to / from / resulted in / because of / injured in / aggravated by / X-related / traumatic) - in the tool's own voice OR put in the patient's mouth: the record says only that symptoms 'began after' the collision, which is temporal. Wording that reproduces what the patient said ('began after') is allowed.
bad_examples: Neck injury caused by the January collision.
Symptoms due to the motor vehicle accident.
The treating physician concluded the symptoms were caused by the January collision.
MRI findings are consistent with a traumatic disc injury.
Neck pain from the January collision.
The crash resulted in a disc protrusion.
Disc protrusion because of the collision.
Patient states the collision caused his symptoms.
Patient states her neck pain is due to the collision.
Persistent neck pain 6/10; prior low back pain (2023) aggravated by the collision.
good_examples: Patient states symptoms began after the January collision.
Per the patient, symptoms began after the January collision.
Symptoms began after the January collision, per patient.
Patient states symptoms began after the January collision; MRI ordered.
Restrained driver rear-ended at approx. 35 mph; neck pain 7/10 and headache.
must_not.pattern: (?i)\b(caused by|due to|result(?:ing|ed)? (?:from|of|in)|secondary to|attributable to|attributed to|stemming from|because of|aggravat\w+\s+(?:by|from|in))\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:\w+\s+){0,3}(?:collision|accident|crash|MVA|trauma)|\b(?:collision|accident|crash|MVA|trauma)[- ](?:related|induced|caused)\b|\bsustained (?:in|during|from)\s+(?:the\s+)?(?:\w+\s+)?(?:collision|accident|crash)|\btrauma(?:tic)?\b|\bfrom the (?:\w+\s+){0,2}(?:collision|accident|crash)|\binjured in\b|\b(?:collision|accident|crash|MVA)\s+(?:caused|resulted in|led to)\b|\bresulted in\b

must_not.statement: Presents the MRI hedge as a finding: 'degenerative' / 'age-related' / 'wear and tear' / 'DDD' without a hedge (may/might/could/possible) in the same clause, or upgrades 'may' to 'likely/consistent with/confirmed'.
bad_examples: MRI confirmed degenerative changes at C5-C6.
Findings consistent with degenerative disc disease.
Patient could not turn head, and MRI shows degenerative disc disease.
good_examples: Findings may represent degenerative change; correlate clinically.
The record states findings may represent degenerative change and to correlate clinically.
MRI findings may be degenerative.
Findings could represent degenerative change.

must_not.statement: Computes a PT total or a grand total that includes PT (9x185=1,665; 12x185=2,220; 8x185=1,480; 8,390 plus those).
good_examples: Billed charges accepted from these records: $8,390 (excludes physical therapy — per-visit rate only, visit count not stated)
Rate $185/visit; visit count not stated (12 planned; discharged at visit 9); needs review.
ER $6,240 and MRI $2,150 total $8,390.

must_not.statement: Merges the two accident dates into one, or states a single accident date without the conflict.
bad_examples: Accident date: 2026-01-09, confirmed by the intake form.
The collision occurred on January 9, 2026 (the intake form agrees).
Date of accident: January 19, 2026 per EMS and ER records.
good_examples: EMS and ER records show treatment on January 9, 2026; the intake form lists the accident as 2026-01-19. The dates conflict.
The intake form gives a different accident date (2026-01-19) than the date of the EMS and ER encounters (2026-01-09).
Accident date appears only on the intake form (record 7): 2026-01-19.

must_not.statement: Reverses or upgrades 'concussion without loss of consciousness' (lost consciousness, with/+ LOC, knocked out, TBI, mild/moderate/severe concussion, post-concussion syndrome, 'no concussion'). Negated wording (without / w/o / no / denies / without any) is faithful and allowed.
bad_examples: Concussion with brief loss of consciousness.
Patient was knocked out at the scene.
Concussion with questionable loss of consciousness.
good_examples: Concussion without loss of consciousness.
Concussion, no loss of consciousness.
Concussion w/o loss of consciousness.
Patient denies loss of consciousness.
Concussion without any loss of consciousness.
Diagnosed with cervical strain and concussion without loss of consciousness; CT head negative.
must_not.pattern: (?i)\b(?:with|had|has|suffered|experienced|positive for|history of)\s+(?:an?\s+)?(?:(?:brief|momentary|transient)\s+)?(?:LOC|loss of consciousness)\b|\bbrief loss of consciousness\b|\+\s*LOC\b|\b(?:lost|losing)\s+consciousness\b|\bknocked out\b|\bunconscious(?:ness)?\b|\bpassed out\b|\bblacked out\b|\bm?TBI\b|traumatic brain|\b(?:possible|questionable|probable|brief)\s+(?:LOC|loss of consciousness)\b|\bLOC\s*(?:x|for)\s*\d|\b(?:mild|moderate|severe|minor)\s+concussion\b|post-?concussion(?:al)?\s+syndrome|\b(?:no|without|negative for|ruled out)\s+concussion\b

must_not.statement: Treats '10 mg', '35 mph', visit counts, pain scores or '3 days' as a dollar amount.
Invents or substitutes a diagnosis not in the records (whiplash, radiculopathy/radicular, stenosis, sprain, disc bulge, nerve root/impingement, spondylosis, myelopathy, fracture).
bad_examples: Findings may represent degenerative disc disease.
good_examples: New onset pain radiating to right arm with numbness in fingers.
Mild right foraminal narrowing at C5-C6.
Cervical strain and concussion without loss of consciousness.
MRI ordered.

must_not.statement: States the patient recovered / was symptom-free (pain was 3/10 at discharge). 'Not fully recovered' and the 2023 low back pain being resolved are allowed.
bad_examples: Patient completed all 12 planned PT visits with full recovery.
good_examples: Pain 3/10 at discharge.
Patient had not fully recovered at discharge (pain 3/10).
Low back pain in 2023, since recovered.
Patient reports low back pain in 2023, resolved.

must_not.statement: Presents the patient's self-report (records 1, 9) as a physician's opinion or examination finding.
bad_examples: The treating physician concluded the symptoms were caused by the January collision.
Dr. at Hill Country attributes the symptoms to the collision.
Examination revealed neck injury with 7/10 pain.
Patient states the collision caused his symptoms.
Patient reports her pain is from the crash.
good_examples: Patient states symptoms began after the January collision.
Per the patient, symptoms started after the January collision; the note records no physician opinion on cause.
41M restrained driver complaining of neck pain 7/10 and headache (C/O).

must_not.statement: Relates the 2023 low back pain to the cervical injury, or says it was ongoing.
bad_examples: Patient has ongoing low back pain from 2023.
The 2023 low back pain contributes to the current cervical condition.
Prior low back injury was aggravated in the collision.
good_examples: Patient reports low back pain in 2023, resolved.
Prior low back pain (2023) reported resolved; a different body region from the cervical complaints.
History of low back pain in 2023, listed as resolved.

must_not.statement: Counts 'missing 3 days of work' as a billed charge or adds it to any total.
bad_examples: Billed charges include 3 missed work days.
Lost wages are added to the $8,390 total.
Total damages: $8,390 plus 3 days of work.
good_examples: Patient reports missing 3 days of work (not a billed charge).
Damages mention, not totaled: patient reports missing 3 days of work.
Missed work is listed separately from billed charges.

must_not.statement: Says the epidural steroid injection was given (record only says 'Recommend').
bad_examples: Patient received a cervical epidural steroid injection.
Epidural steroid injection was administered on 2026-06-12.
She underwent an epidural steroid injection.
good_examples: Cervical epidural steroid injection recommended.
Recommend cervical epidural steroid injection.
Follow-up: injection recommended; patient states symptoms began after the January collision.
Cervical ESI recommended.

must_not.statement: Escalates 'degenerative change' into a disease or diagnosis (degenerative disc disease, DDD, disc disease), even when hedged.
bad_examples: Findings may represent degenerative disc disease.
good_examples: Findings may represent degenerative change; correlate clinically.
The record states findings may represent degenerative change and to correlate clinically.
C5-C6 disc protrusion with mild right foraminal narrowing.

must_not.statement: Swaps laterality: the records say RIGHT arm / RIGHT foraminal narrowing and never mention left.
good_examples: New onset pain radiating to right arm with numbness in fingers.
Mild right foraminal narrowing at C5-C6.
Right arm pain with numbness in fingers.

must_not.statement: Labels the patient non-compliant / failed to attend (the record states two missed appointments and a discharge; the tool quotes, it does not characterize).
bad_examples: Patient failed to attend two PT visits.
good_examples: Discharged from PT after two missed appointments.
Visit 9: discharged from physical therapy after two missed appointments; pain 3/10.
Pain 3/10 at discharge.

must_not.statement: Dates the record-7 entry with its body date (2026-01-19) instead of the header date 2026-05-18 (R-TL-3).

notes: Records 1 and 2 share a date (2026-01-09) but are different providers: separate entries. Appendix C pairing '1->3: 7' means distinct-date gap 2026-01-09 to 2026-01-16.
sample.export.expected.txt is the byte-exact expected export (letter block + internal notes), copied from REQUIREMENTS section 6.
